title: eora baueri
intro: Eora baueri, commonly known as the sandalwood, is a species of flowering plant in the family Santalaceae. The health benefits of Eora baueri include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve sleep quality due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in aromatherapy, as the essential oil extracted from its roots is known to have sedative and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Eora baueri include α-santalol, β-santalol, and other sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
